item.title: Qi Gong (Mindful Movement) at Barbieri Park in Healdsburg — Sat Oct 10, 10:00 AM — Barbieri Park
item.description:
Marianne Benforado, Licensed Acupuncturist and Certified Qi Gong Teacher will offer a mindful movement class at Barbieri Park in Healdsburg on Saturday, October 10 and Saturday, October 24, from 10–11 am. $20 drop in. Come to either or both!
There’s something really special about practicing Qi Gong outside. It's a good reminder that we’re part of Nature. We move with the trees, feel our feet on the grass, breathe the fresh air, listen to the birdies and take in the long view toward the hills and vineyards. All senses engaged!
It’s a beautiful way to get out of our heads for awhile. No experience is needed. Really! Just show up and mirror the movements. Come a few minutes early to pay and get registered.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Cookbook Club — Sat Oct 10, 12:00 PM — Sonoma Valley Library
item.description: Are you interested in trying new recipes or just wanting to get out of your cooking comfort zone? A cookbook book club blends the joy of reading with the creativity of cooking and the warmth of sharing meals. Browse a selection of themed cookbooks every month, then prepare and share your meals for the next meeting! June: Celebrating Julia in June! Julia Child & Those Influenced by Her. Before "food TV" was a genre, Julia Child was teaching America to cook-joyfully, loudly, and with plenty of permission to make mistakes. Her landmark cookbook Mastering the Art of French Cooking helped translate French technique for American home kitchens launching a whole new way of learning to cook. For this meeting, bring a dish by Julia Child or by chefs influenced by her and who share her spirit-like Jacques Pépin, her longtime cooking partner on public television, and Ina Garten, who has spoken about admiring Child's "courage of her convictions." July: Savoring Summer, Italian-Style. Think Italian

item.title: MEET THE ARTIST RECEPTION painter Aaron Webb THE ALCHEMY OF DISTANT TIDES — Sat Oct 10, 12:00 PM — Rena Charles Gallery
item.description:
MEET THE ARTIST RECEPTION Saturday, October 10th, 2026 Noon - 4pm
THE ALCHEMY OF DISTANT TIDES Abstract Paintings by Aaron Webb
In The Alchemy of Distant Tides, abstract painter and Navy sailor Aaron Webb continues to explore the places we leave, the places we seek, and, most compellingly, the ways memory transforms both. Through saltwater, oxidation, layered surfaces, and elemental materials, these paintings trace the passage between experience and remembrance; where distance becomes longing, time becomes patina, and the sea becomes both memory and metaphor.
Explore a new body of work shaped by the wild sea and the transformative forces of time and tide.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.description:

We'll be performing our upbeat blend of original rock plus classic hits you know and love from the 60s-80s (Beatles, Hendrix, CCR, Doors, Pink Floyd, Tom Petty, Police, Men At Work, U2, Gerry Rafferty, Tears for Fears, Steve Miller, Stevie Wonder, Steely Dan, and more!).
We'll be in full four piece form featuring band founder and songwriter Jason E Davies on guitar and vocals, Travis Thayer on keys, sax, and vocals, Rob Neidel on bass and vocals, and Chris Oatman on drums! Whether you enjoy searing guitar and sax solos, dynamic and danceable rhythms, or captivating songs, you're going to love it!

item.title: Funky Florals | Cut Paper Collage Workshop with Sally-Ann Langley — Sat Oct 10, 1:00 PM — Petaluma Arts Center
item.description:
Get ready to play with color, pattern, and shape in this fun, whimsical collage workshop! You'll create your very own Funky Floral artwork using painted papers, colorful patterns, and playful floral and leaf shapes.
You'll make your own painted collage papers, add colorful patterns with paint pens, then get snipping and cutting your flowers and leaves. From there, you'll experiment with composition and arrange your pieces into a funky floral design that's uniquely yours. Create a 9x11 artwork or a collection of notecards and gift tags!
The emphasis is on having fun and playing with your creativity, even if you've never created a collage before. Sally-Ann will demonstrate each step and cheer you on along the way.

item.title: The Los Angeles Breakfast Club at Resort-O-Rama — Sat Oct 10, 1:30 PM — Flamingo Resort & Spa
item.description: The Los Angeles Breakfast Club goes on the road... to Resort-O-Rama in Santa Rosa, CA! Join Club Historian Rachel Skytt and Sandi Hemmerlein, author of the LABC centennial history book, for a presentation on the history — and fabulous vacations — of The Los Angeles Breakfast Club on Saturday afternoon, October 10 at 1:30 p.m. The Breakfast Club became internationally famous in the 1920s and '30s as the premier host organization of Los Angeles, counting many Hollywood stars, starlets, and studio execs among its upper-crust ranks. Now known as The Los Angeles Breakfast Club, the "Club of Hospitality" recently celebrated its centennial and once again welcomes a parade of prominent performers, politicians, and personalities — but every Wednesday morning, everyone who comes to Friendship Auditorium for breakfast is just a regular ol' Ham or an Egg. item.title: BEAT: Belew/Vai/Levin/Bozzio Performing the Music of KING CRIMSON — Sat Oct 10, 8:00 PM — Blue Note Napa Summer Sessions
item.description:
Following more than 100 acclaimed performances across North and South America, Europe, and Japan, BEAT returns this fall for the last North American tour. Former King Crimson members Adrian Belew and Tony Levin are joined by guitar virtuoso Steve Vai and legendary drummer Terry Bozzio to perform the music of the three landmark 1980s King Crimson albums: Discipline, Beat, and Three of a Perfect Pair. Rather than attempting to recreate the original recordings, BEAT brings this extraordinary music to life with the spirit, precision, and adventurousness that made it so enduring. Whether you've lived with these albums for decades or are discovering them for the first time, this is the final opportunity to experience one of progressive music's most celebrated catalogs performed by four of the best musicians on the planet.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.
